Package com.listochef.repository

Class MongoUserRepository

java.lang.Object
com.listochef.repository.MongoUserRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
UserRepository
@Repository public class MongoUserRepository extends Object implements UserRepository
MongoDB implementation of UserRepository. This class handles all user-related persistence logic using the "users" collection, including authentication data, profile information, pantry/grocery lists, saved recipes, and tickets.
